title: Length is the spaces between the ends

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A strip lies on a ruler. Its length is how many equal spaces fit between its ends.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each space on this ruler is one centimeter, written c m.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The numbers count the spaces from zero: one, two, three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: From zero, the end mark is the length.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Slide the strip. The same three spaces travel with it.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The strip runs from A to B. What is its length in centimeters?

do.text: The strip runs from $A$ to $B$. What is its length in cm?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: It ends at the six mark, so it is six centimeters long.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: That six counts the spaces from zero. Three of them are before the strip, on the bare ruler.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Only three are under the strip. Six minus three is three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: That is end mark minus start mark.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A twig and a string lie along a measuring tape.

do.text: A twig and a string lie along a measuring tape. How much longer is the string than the twig? Answer in centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: How much longer is the string than the twig? Answer in centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The twig is seven minus two, five.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The string is ten minus one, nine.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Slide both to zero.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The string reaches four spaces past the twig.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Nine minus five: the string is four centimeters longer.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A ribbon lies on the top ruler and a paper strip lies on the bottom ruler.

do.text: A ribbon lies on the top ruler and a paper strip lies on the bottom ruler. Both rulers are marked in centimeters. Measure both objects. Which is longer, and by how much?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Both rulers are marked in centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Measure both objects. Which is longer, and by how much?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The paper strip sticks out farther to the right, but it starts at three, not at zero.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The ribbon is eight minus zero, eight. The paper strip is ten minus three, seven.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Eight minus seven is one, so the ribbon is one centimeter longer.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A ruler counts spaces from zero. Compare lengths, not end marks.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Length is the spaces between the ends: end mark minus start mark.
